ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB$ is the diameter of the circle $\odot O$, and $\odot O$ intersects side $AE$ of $\triangle ABE$ at point $D$. Connect $OD$, and it satisfies $OD\parallel BE$. Point $P$ is on the extension line of $BA$, and $PD$ intersects $BE$ at point $C$. $AB=BE$; If $PA=2$, $\angle B=60^\circ$, $PC\perp BE$, find the length of diameter $AB$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle PCB=90^\circ$ and $\angle B=60^\circ$, it follows that $\angle P=30^\circ$. From this, we have $OD\parallel BE$, hence $\angle B=\angle DOA=60^\circ$. Also, since $OA=OD$, it follows that $\triangle AOD$ is an equilateral triangle, thus $AD=OA$, and $\angle DAO=60^\circ$. Therefore, $\angle ADP=\angle P=30^\circ$, which implies that $PA=AD=OA=2$, hence $AB=2OA=\boxed{4}$.

method.method_draft: Coordinate-analytic route. First read from the image that AB is horizontal with P to the left of A, O midway between A and B, E above the segment, D on the upper-left arc and on AE, and PD is the same line as PC. Set A=(0,0), let AB=x, so B=(x,0), O=(x/2,0), and P=(-2,0) because PA=2. From AB=BE and angle B=60°, place E at B plus a length-x vector making 60° above BA, so E=(x/2, sqrt(3)x/2). Since OD is parallel to BE, the radius OD points in direction (-1/2, sqrt(3)/2), so D=O+(x/2)(-1/2, sqrt(3)/2)=(x/4, sqrt(3)x/4), which is also on AE. Now impose PC perpendicular BE; because P,D,C are collinear, line PD is perpendicular to BE. The slope of BE is -sqrt(3), so the slope of PD must be 1/sqrt(3). Compute slope(PD)=(sqrt(3)x/4)/(x/4+2)=sqrt(3)x/(x+8). Set sqrt(3)x/(x+8)=1/sqrt(3), giving 3x=x+8 and x=4. Therefore AB=4.

图像描述：图中 AB 是水平线段，P 在 A 的左侧并位于 BA 的延长线上，O 在 AB 中点处；圆以 O 为圆心且 AB 为直径。E 在 AB 上方，AE 与圆交于 D，D 位于圆的左上方；线段 OD 与 BE 方向相同、平行；P、D、C 在同一直线上，C 位于 BE 上，且 PC 垂直 BE。

推理：按坐标解析法，设 A=(0,0)，AB=x，则 B=(x,0)，O=(x/2,0)。因为 PA=2 且 P 在 A 左侧，所以 P=(-2,0)。由 AB=BE=x 且 ∠B=60°，BE 从 B 出发相对于 BA 方向向上成 60°，所以 E=(x/2,√3x/2)。由于 OD∥BE，OD 的方向向量可取 (-1/2,√3/2)，而 OD 是半径，长度为 x/2，因此 D=O+(x/2)(-1/2,√3/2)=(x/4,√3x/4)。又 P、D、C 共线，且 PC⊥BE，所以直线 PD⊥BE。BE 的斜率为 (√3x/2-0)/(x/2-x)=-√3，因此 PD 的斜率应为 1/√3。计算 PD 的斜率：m_PD=(√3x/4-0)/(x/4-(-2))=(√3x/4)/(x/4+2)=√3x/(x+8)。令 √3x/(x+8)=1/√3，得 3x=x+8，所以 2x=8，x=4。因此直径 AB=4。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB$ is the diameter of the circle $\odot O$, and $\odot O$ intersects side $AE$ of $\triangle ABE$ at point $D$. Connect $OD$, and it satisfies $OD\parallel BE$. Point $P$ is on the extension line of $BA$, and $PD$ intersects $BE$ at point $C$. $AB=BE$; if $PA=2$, $\angle B=60^\circ$, and $PC\perp BE$, find the length of diameter $AB$.
raw_record.answer: \textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle PCB=90^\circ$ and $\angle B=60^\circ$, it follows that $\angle P=30^\circ$. From this, we have $OD\parallel BE$, hence $\angle B=\angle DOA=60^\circ$. Also, since $OA=OD$, it follows that $\triangle AOD$ is an equilateral triangle, thus $AD=OA$, and $\angle DAO=60^\circ$. Therefore, $\angle ADP=\angle P=30^\circ$, which implies that $PA=AD=OA=2$, hence $AB=2OA=\boxed{4}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, a horizontal straight line can be seen, marked from left to right in order as P, A, O, B; P is on the left-side extension line of BA, O is the center of the circle, and AB is the horizontal diameter of the circle. Point D is at the upper left of the circle, and at the same time is located on side AE from A upward to E; point E is above, and B and E are connected to form the oblique side BE. Segment OD connects from the center O of the circle to D, and its direction is parallel to BE. Straight line PD continues to intersect BE at C, therefore P, D, C are collinear, and C is on BE.
Reasoning: Because P, D, C are collinear, PC and PD are the same straight line. It is also known that PC ⟂ BE, and C, B are on BE, so in triangle PBC, ∠PCB=90°. Since PB and BA are collinear, BC and BE are collinear, and it is known that ∠B=60°, therefore ∠P=180°-90°-60°=30°. Also because OD ∥ BE, and OA and BA are collinear, ∠DOA=∠B=60°. OA and OD are both radii of the circle, therefore OA=OD, and triangle AOD is an isosceles triangle with vertex angle 60°, so it is an equilateral triangle, obtaining AD=OA, and ∠DAO=60°. Since AP is the opposite extension line of AO, ∠DAP=180°-60°=120°. In triangle APD, ∠APD=30°, ∠DAP=120°, therefore ∠ADP=30°. Thus ∠APD=∠ADP, so AD=AP. It is known that PA=2, so AD=2. Also AD=OA, so OA=2. The diameter AB=2OA=4.
